about: Hand-written entries for z88v47.rom.dis that the OZ source does not provide (dev/plans/Z88_OZ47_ROM_ANNOTATIONS_PLAN.md, Phase 3). dev/scripts/import-oz-source.cjs --all applies them after the import, so a re-import keeps them: a label replaces the one at its offset, a synopsis or comment replaces the imported one, a region replaces the regions it overlaps, and a bank the import does not cover gets its page from `page`. Every entry carries its provenance (observed, manual or derived); offsets are bank offsets. Written in Klive's own words.

labels.name: bsf_crash
labels.synopsis: Hangs in a loop to itself: OS_Mfr could not give the RAM page the bad-memory handler asked for.

labels.name: u1_crash
labels.synopsis: Hangs in a loop to itself: OS_Mfr could not give the RAM page asked for.

labels.name: OSBye_crash
labels.synopsis: Hangs in a loop to itself: DC_Bye does not come back to the process that ended.

labels.name: dordel_crash
labels.synopsis: Hangs in a loop to itself when B is 0.

labels.name: cerh_crash
labels.synopsis: Hangs in a loop to itself: the call to $00B7 before it is not expected to come back.

labels.name: opdir_crash
labels.synopsis: Hangs in a loop to itself: OS_Dor failed while the directory was opened.

labels.name: PrevCmd_crash
labels.synopsis: Hangs in a loop to itself when HL - DE borrows (Fc set).

labels.name: NextCmd_crash
labels.synopsis: Hangs in a loop to itself when HL + DE overflows (Fc set).

labels.name: aab_crash
labels.synopsis: Hangs in a loop to itself when Fc is set, an error from the call before it.

labels.name: init_crash
labels.synopsis: Hangs in a loop to itself: OS_Bye does not come back.

labels.name: Exit_crash
labels.synopsis: Hangs in a loop to itself: OS_Bye does not come back.

labels.name: FileArea
labels.synopsis:
The ROM's FlashStore file area, the preset 'oz' file area below the OZ banks. It holds one
file entry: the name's length, the name, the file's length (4 bytes, low byte first) and its
bytes. The rest of the bank is $FF, free space for more entries.

labels.name: WelcomeData
labels.synopsis:
The file, a PipeDream document: the OZ 4.7 release notes (filearea/welcome.pdd in the
OZ source).

labels.name: FileAreaFree
labels.synopsis: Free space to the end of the bank: every byte $FF.
